The verses are cited or referred to in several later canonical and paracanonical works, including the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 6, Ne 37), the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 2), the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 15), and the Vinaya *Parivāra* (Pvr 10).

Curated passage-level parallels are attested in both Pali and non-Pali corpora: in the Pali Canon, corresponding material appears in the *Udāna* (Ud 5.5), the Vinaya *Khandhaka* (Kd 19), and the *Saṃyutta Nikāya* (SN 1.66); outside Pali, parallels are found in the *Udānavarga* (UV 6 Śīlavarga), its Tibetan translation (*Uv Kg* 6), and two Chinese translations (T 212.7 and T 213.6).
